description: Show / hide a PSD layer, its opacity (0-100) or blend mode. Layer names from spb_status. Mask / Wire / Car_Mandatory are template layers (off before export). Never hide the body paint layer unasked.
name: spb_edit_layer

description: The design library: scheme presets (retro lower band, classic stripes, two-tone, colour block, bookends, stealth), elements (lower band, pinstripe, twin stripes, centre stripe, bumpers, roof, hood...), proportions and composition rules, and the palette for an era / brand / theme ("Gulf", "70s", "stealth"). Use it to PROPOSE options before spb_apply_scheme.

query.description: the buyer's theme in a few words

name: spb_design_recipes

description: Lay out a WHOLE paint scheme on the named parts in one call (exact bands; base colour first, later zones stack above). Preset id or elements list, palette (base / a / b / c / trim, or palette_id from spb_design_recipes), paint_finish ("base::matte" / "base::gloss" / "base::satin"), trim_finish. ASK FIRST: only when the buyer asked for a full livery with colours, approved your proposal, or said "surprise me / just do it": then confirm:true. Otherwise offer 2-3 options and wait. The body base keeps the accent art already on the car. Returns zones_touched (zone 0 = top), measured {verdict, outside_px, decal_px, line} and the preview: report from those. Pass buyer_said (their words). Vague / mood / reference / complaint words get ask_back: nothing changes, ask the buyer.

buyer_said.description: REQUIRED: the buyer's own words for this change, quoted (add the earlier line when they refer back: "make it so"). The app reads them: vague / mood / reference / complaint words return ask_back and change nothing.

confirm.description: true only when the buyer's words ask for exactly this whole-car change (colours/finish + layout named), approved your proposal, or said "surprise me / just do it".

elements.description: optional custom list; each {id, colour (hex, name or role), colour2, from, to, at, width, trim}

keep_accents.description: default true: the base colour replaces only the car's main body colour, the buyer's other body art stays. false only when the buyer wants that art painted over.

preset.description: retro_lower_band | classic_stripes | two_tone | colour_block | bookends | stealth | solid (base colour only)

name: spb_apply_scheme

Part space: u 0..1 front to rear, v 0..1 roof-line to rocker. part default both sides; colours 1-3 #hex (one zone each); paint_finish for the strokes. Typical: rings {cu:0.38, cv:0.6, r0:0.1, r1:0.95, n:8, facing:"front", span:150}; speed_lines {u0:0.4, u1:0.95, v0:0.15, v1:0.85, n:16}. Place above a base colour. Describe the result from the returned zones. Pass buyer_said (their words). Vague / mood / reference / complaint words get ask_back: nothing changes, ask the buyer.

buyer_said.description: REQUIRED: the buyer's own words for this change, quoted (add the earlier line when they refer back: "make it so"). The app reads them: vague / mood / reference / complaint words return ask_back and change nothing.

description: Read the buyer's live render + iRacing setup: user ID, number mode, car folder, files in it (paint, spec, .mip, age), template layers on, render state, engine health. Call FIRST when paint will not render, is missing in iRacing or looks different in the sim.
name: spb_check_setup

description: Zones (what each covers, what it really wins, what blocks it, its look), PSD layers and the main colours. Only to double-check.

editor_query.description: Optional buyer question for focused current layer-material evidence; read-only.

name: spb_get_state

description: THE tool for "which finish for X": ranks the whole catalogue (~4,800 looks) for this car. part, goal (pop|premium|shimmer|deep|retro|stealth|readable|subtle), ask = the buyer's own words (negations honoured), novelty (safe|balanced|wild), lane (keep = shine only | complete | texture), exclude (keys already shown: pass them for NEW options), page. like + mods (calm, bold, darker, lighter, glossier, flatter, sparklier, metalmore, metalless, warmer, cooler, vivid, muted...) = "like X but calmer". leave_out = traits they do not want. Rows: look, why, loud / busy 1-5, apply hint. Use it to build the 2-3 OPTIONS you offer.

stack.description: Default: on. When the ask names 2+ layers, the result carries stack (layers with adjust = base_colour / hue_shift_deg / saturation / brightness / spec_strength ...

name: spb_suggest_finishes

description: Search the catalogue (~4,800 looks) by meaning: query plus facets colour, shine (mirror|gloss|satin|matte), metal (none..full), sparkle, texture, own / takes colour, shelf, type (finish|base|monolithic), tags, min_quality, exclude. Returns up to 10 {key, name, look, about}. Use several differently-worded queries.
name: spb_find_finishes

description: The catalogue map: all shelves (no argument) or one shelf's best items.
name: spb_browse_catalog

description: Full spec sheet of ONE finish (key or name): palette, own / takes colour, measured metal / roughness / clearcoat, scale, sparkle, quality, best use, deep notes.
name: spb_finish_details

description: Side-by-side facts for up to 6 finish keys.
name: spb_compare_finishes

description: Find SPEC patterns (how a surface reflects: flake, sparkle, brushed, holographic prism, weave, weathering) by words. Returns up to 10 {id, name, effect}. Use the id in spec_patterns.
name: spb_find_spec_patterns

description: Find visible PAINT patterns (carbon weave, camo, hex, scales...) by words. Returns up to 10 {id, name, effect}. Use the id in pattern.
name: spb_find_patterns

description: What this paint really shows, in painter words: its colours (share, hex, where), the numbers / sponsors / stripes layers, and the looks spb_refinish understands. Call it FIRST before changing what the car already shows, and to answer complaints ("looks plastic") with facts.
name: spb_describe_paint

Check per_box and the image; add more with replace:false.

boxes.description: [x0,y0,x1,y1] fractions 0..1, each at most ~10% of the sheet (logos 12%)

mode.description: auto = numbers glyph, sponsors logo, stripes colour_in_region

none.description: true (boxes not needed) = there are NONE of this kind on this paint

replace.description: default true = forget earlier marks of this kind; false = add to them

spread.description: colour_in_region only; connected (default) = follow the stripe past the box edge (capped), box = only inside ...

name: spb_mark_elements

(a look ALONE keeps the colours); colour = a new colour; relative glossier | duller. On a flat paint, numbers / sponsors / stripes without boxes return needs_confirmation: tell the buyer to answer the card, claim nothing. Prefer spb_do. Pass buyer_said (their words). Vague / mood / reference / complaint words get ask_back: nothing changes, ask the buyer.

boxes.description: only for numbers / sponsors / stripes on a flat paint:

mark_mode.description: with boxes: how spb_mark_elements reads them (auto = numbers glyph, sponsors logo, stripes colour_in_region)

object.description: optional: a THING the buyer named that holds the target colour ("the yellow on the spray can" = target ...

part.description: optional: limit a COLOUR target to a PLACE:

same_as.description: COPY LOOK (HELPER FIX PASS 8): where the look to copy is:

same_colour.description: with same_as: the colour word the buyer said for it ("the purple on the numbers" = "purple"), to pick the ...

spread.description: with boxes, colour_in_region: connected (default) follows the stripe past the box edge, capped

target.description: a colour on the car (from spb_describe_paint), numbers, sponsors, stripes, main colour, or a part name

texture.description: optional (FIRSTTEST): a TEXTURE in the SAME zone as the colour / look:

texture_mode.description: shine (default) = a spec pattern (only the reflection changes); pattern = drawn in the paint

name: spb_refinish

description: The car layout: what each PSD layer is (body paint / numbers / sponsors / tape / decals / template) and the NAMED PARTS (where, which end is the front, which edge is the roof-line). parts_not_known_yet: call spb_request_parts before designing.
name: spb_get_car_map

description: Change an EXISTING zone by zone_id or unique zone_name (preferred), or index + expect_name. Pass only what changes; fields and meanings as in spb_add_zone. A zone that covers most of the car needs confirm:true. Returns measured {verdict, outside_px, decal_px, line} and the preview. For edits of existing paint prefer spb_do. Pass buyer_said (their words). Vague / mood / reference / complaint words get ask_back: nothing changes, ask the buyer.

buyer_said.description: REQUIRED: the buyer's own words for this change, quoted (add the earlier line when they refer back: "make it so"). The app reads them: vague / mood / reference / complaint words return ask_back and change nothing.

confirm.description: true only when the buyer's words ask for exactly this whole-car change (colours/finish + layout named), approved your proposal, or said "surprise me / just do it".

expect_name.description: fail if the resolved zone has a different name

zone.description: zone index; use expect_name to guard against reordered zones

name: spb_edit_zone

description: Create a NEW zone (goes on top unless priority says otherwise). region is required: {part} (preferred), colours (+tolerance), layers, element, remaining / everything (whole car: needs confirm:true). Returns what the region selects, which zones it takes pixels from, measured {verdict, outside_px, decal_px, line} and the preview. For edits of existing paint prefer spb_do. Pass buyer_said (their words). Vague / mood / reference / complaint words get ask_back: nothing changes, ask the buyer.

base_strength.description: number 0-200 (%) — fade the finish over the original paint (0 = original paint, 100 = full finish)

buyer_said.description: REQUIRED: the buyer's own words for this change, quoted (add the earlier line when they refer back: "make it so"). The app reads them: vague / mood / reference / complaint words return ask_back and change nothing.

color.description: string — "#rrggbb" (paint the zone this solid colour), "source" (keep the car's own paint colour, change only the spec/shine), or "finish" (use the finish's own colour)

confirm.description: true only when the buyer's words ask for exactly this whole-car change (colours/finish + layout named), approved your proposal, or said "surprise me / just do it".

finish.description: string — a finish key from spb_find_finishes: "base::<id>" (plain material) or "monolithic::<id>" (complete special look). Replaces the zone's base material / special.

gradient.description: object {stops:[{pos:0-100,color:"#rrggbb"},...2-10 stops], direction:"horizontal"|"vertical"|"diagonal_down"|"diagonal_up"|"radial"|"angular", fit:true|false} — colour the zone with a gradient (turns colour mode to gradient). A stop colour may be a colour name; stops without pos are spread evenly.

intensity.description: number 0-100 — how strongly the FINISH acts (its spec / shine and its paint effect; 100 = full). It does NOT fade the zone colour: for that use base_strength

muted.description: boolean — temporarily switch the zone off (or on)

pattern.description: object {id|"none", opacity:0-100, scale:0.05-5, rotation:0-359} — a paint PATTERN on top (ids from spb_find_patterns); opacity 100 = the colours of the pattern itself cover the zone colour, 25-35 = the zone colour with the pattern texture (measured 2026-10-05:

priority.description: for spb_add_zone / move: "top" (default for a new zone; wins overlaps), "bottom", or a position number 0.. (0 = top). LOWER position wins where zones overlap, so a zone that must show on pixels other zones also select has to sit ABOVE them.

region.description: WHICH PIXELS: part:"left side" or ["left side","right side"] (a NAMED part: the way to place anything) with portion:"front third"|"lower third"|"rear half"... or band:{axis:"height"|"length", from, to} (height 0 = roof-line .. 1 = rocker; length 0 = front .. 1 = rear); colors:["#hex"] + tolerance 6-100; layers:["layer name"]; element:"numbers"|"sponsors"|"stripes" (flat paints, spb_describe_paint first); exclude:["numbers","sponsors","stripes"]; cells / rect only for details under ~12% of the sheet; remaining:true (everything not claimed); everything:true + paintable:true = a whole-car base (confirm:true).

part.description: a named part or a list of parts

scale.description: number 0.05-5 — size of the base material texture (1 = normal)

second_base.description: object {id|"none", color:"#rrggbb", strength:0-100} — a second material blended over the first (ids like finish keys)

spec_patterns.description: array (max 5) of {id, opacity:0-100, scale, rotation, channels:"M"|"R"|"C" letters (Metal/Rough/Clearcoat)} — SPEC pattern layers that change how the surface reflects (ids from spb_find_spec_patterns). Replaces the existing spec pattern stack.

spec_shift.description: object {metal:-127..127, rough:-127..127, clearcoat:-127..127} — push the zone's metallic / roughness / clearcoat channels up or down (added to the spec bytes: rough minus = sharper/glossier; clearcoat minus = glossier coat, stops at 16 = max gloss; clearcoat plus = duller coat)

spec_strength.description: number 0-200 (%) — overall strength of the spec (shine/metal) map

name: spb_add_zone

Use it when the buyer wants a new base look over most of the car or to start over, instead of muting zones one by one; then edit the catch-all for the new base and stack extra looks in the kept zones.

buyer_said.description: REQUIRED: the buyer's own words for this change, quoted (add the earlier line when they refer back: "make it so"). The app reads them: vague / mood / reference / complaint words return ask_back and change nothing.

confirm.description: true only when the buyer's words ask for exactly this whole-car change (colours/finish + layout named), approved your proposal, or said "surprise me / just do it".

keep.description: zone ids or exact zone names to keep (e.g. the numbers zone the buyer still wants)

name: spb_reset_zones

description: PREFERRED for any change to what the car already shows (recolour, finish, outline, pinline, stripe, gradient, pattern, copy a look, thinner / bigger / lighter, "everything except the roof"). Send a frame {v:1, act:"change", ops:[{verb, target, look, except?, relative?}], keep?, decals:"protect"} plus text = the buyer's own words (REQUIRED: the app checks the frame against them). One op per clause. verb: recolour | refinish (shine only: look.finish {family, keep_colour:true}) | restyle | outline | pinline | stripe | gradient | pattern | copy_look | adjust (relative {prop, dir, amount}) | hide | show. target.kind: part (parts: hood, roof, trunk, spoiler, front bumper, rear bumper, left side, right side) | layer (exact names from spb_status) | colour | element (numbers | sponsors | stripes) | body (whole car, needs confirm:true) | zone. Name ONLY the parts the buyer named ("the right door" = right side only; a part named as the reference, "same as the left", is not a target). look: {colour:{word|hex}, finish:{family | key, keep_colour}, pattern:{concept|id}, gradient, stroke:{width}, spec}. Finish families the app knows: chrome, satin chrome, dark chrome, metallic, pearl, candy, brushed, matte, satin, gloss, carbon. ANY other look (holo, flake, glitter, chameleon...): spb_find_finishes first and pass look.finish.key. Returns applied, measured {verdict, changed_px, outside_px, decal_px, findings, line}, undo, preview. verdict ok = clean; reported / substituted / reverted = tell the buyer exactly that. If it returns ask: NOTHING changed, put the question to the buyer. dry_run:true = plan only.

confirm.description: true only when the buyer's words ask for exactly this whole-car change (colours/finish + layout named), approved your proposal, or said "surprise me / just do it".

dry_run.description: true = plan and check the scope, change nothing

items.description: a Target, same shape as ops[].target

ops.description: act=change: one op per clause, in the order said

items.description: a Target, same shape as ops[].target

look.description: What it should become; leave out what does not change.

accent.description: an accent / trim with NO shape named: the app asks outline-or-band

family.description: chrome | satin chrome | dark chrome | metallic | pearl | candy | brushed | matte | satin | gloss | carbon ...

keep_colour.description: true = only the shine changes, colours stay

key.description: a catalogue key from spb_find_finishes, only if you looked it up

stops.description: colour words / #hex in order; "clear" = fades to the paint underneath

scale.description: texture scale: 1 = as is, 0.3 = crushed to 30%, 2 = twice as big

ref.description: a Target, same shape as ops[].target

amount.description: little | lot | half | double | back | a number

source.description: copy_look: where the look comes from (a Target)

target.description: Target: what a change applies to.

between.description: pinline: the two Targets whose seam gets the line

graphic.description: kind=graphic: the existing look to edit (carbon, camo, flames, stripe, checker, hex ...)

layers.description: PSD layer names exactly as STATE.layers

object.description: a thing that is NOT a part or layer (spray can, mirrors, skull): descriptor only

parts.description: car-map part names exactly as STATE.parts ("both sides" = two names)

portion.description: front half | rear half | lower third | upper half | top edge | ...

replace_last.description: this request REPLACES the last change ("no, do X instead")

text.description: REQUIRED: the buyer's own words for this change, quoted (add the earlier line when they refer back: "make it so"). The app reads them: vague / mood / reference / complaint words return ask_back and change nothing.

name: spb_do

description: What did the LAST change really do, measured on the rendered paint: paint / spec / outside / decal pixels, findings, the app's line, still applied or undone. Read-only. Call it when the buyer asks you to verify. fresh:true re-measures now. A 256 grid: a hairline can read 0.

fresh.description: true = measure again now (against the picture taken just before the change)

name: spb_check

description: SEE the flat paint with a 0.1 ruler plus the app's guess of numbers (pink), sponsors (blue), stripes (yellow). For flat paints before spb_mark_elements. region [x0,y0,x1,y1] or {part} = that area at full resolution.

app_guess.description: false = do not include the app's own guess (default true for the whole sheet, false for a zoom)

region.description: optional [x0,y0,x1,y1] as fractions of the whole sheet (or an object with part = a part name, e.g. left side, for that part box):

name: spb_look_at_paint
